comparison_with_bm25.key_improvement: Dense retrieval resolves the query 'theft' directly to Section 303 (Theft) at Rank 1 (Sim: 0.7764), correcting the lexical frequency bias of BM25 which ranked Section 112 at #1.

limitations: LSA dense embeddings map term co-occurrences into a continuous 128-dimensional vector space, but do not capture complex deep-learning context like multi-head transformer models.
Synthetic or unseen out-of-vocabulary legal terms require TF-IDF sub-word n-gram overlap to project into the LSA semantic subspace.
notes: Generated 392 dense 128-dimensional vector embeddings for BNS 2023 chunks. Evaluated on 10 baseline queries: Hit@1 = 88.89%, Hit@3 = 100.0%, MRR = 0.9259. Status: SUCCESS.
